channel.title: NIL Brand Academy Blog
channel.description: Straight-talk NIL guides for student-athletes and parents.

item.title: What Is NIL? The Complete Guide for Athletes (2026)
item.description: NIL means Name, Image & Likeness. Learn what NIL is, how deals work, who's eligible, and how to start the right way. A beginner's guide for athletes & parents.

item.title: How to Get Your First NIL Deal (Step-by-Step)
item.description: Learn how to get NIL deals as a student-athlete. A step-by-step system to build your assets, pitch brands, and land your first deal the professional way.

item.title: How to Build an Athlete Media Kit (Step-by-Step)
item.description: Learn exactly what to include in an athlete media kit, how to present a small audience well, and how to make brands say yes. Step-by-step guide.

item.title: How Small-Following Athletes Land Real NIL Deals
item.description: Think you need 100K followers for an NIL deal? A USC athlete landed multiple brand partnerships on ~10K. Here's the professional playbook that gets small-audience athletes paid.

item.title: NIL Disclosure & FTC Rules for Athletes
item.description: Learn NIL disclosure rules the pro way: when to use #ad, how the FTC endorsement guides work, and how to stay compliant and get rehired. Education, not legal advice.
